messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD1234 fired for service=runtime-proxy - severity=critical - symptom=5xx-rate-rise
maria: acked via PagerDuty, taking first look
devon: on it, checking metrics in grafana -> dashboard: runtime/requests
maria: I'm seeing a sharp, short 5xx spike in us-west-2; looks like 3 dedicated pools showing increased reject rates :thinking_face:
nora: any deploys in the last 10m?
devon: no deploys in infra since 15m, but there was a canary bump for a routing change ~8m ago
aj: I'm seeing repeated pages from incident-bot, about 6 in the last 3m — possible flapping threshold
maria: can we silence for the next 10m while we validate? I'll create a temporary suppression on PD
maria: /pd silence --service runtime-proxy --duration 10m --note "investigating transient spike"
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD1234 marked silenced by maria
devon: capturing logs from proxy in us-west-2:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:21Z proxy: downstream 5xx increased 18->120 rps
auth-cache: cache-miss burst while kv-prefill running
route-evaluator: fallback to expensive route for 2% of requests
```
nora: kv warmup + fallback routing could explain short blips. any customer-facing errors reported?
aj: support flagged 2 customers in us-west-2 with increased errors, both on dedicated capacity; ticket numbers #1842, #1843
maria: impact limited and transient, no broad outage. we'll keep PD silenced while we monitor and roll back routing change if needed
devon: initiated rollback of routing canary: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime-router -n prod --to-revision=42`
ops-bot: rollout undo accepted, new rollout started: revision 42
maria: watching p95 and 5xx now
nora: after rollback, 5xx dropped back to baseline within 45s :party_parrot:
aj: re-enabling PD alerting for the service
maria: /pd unsilence --service runtime-proxy
incident-bot: PagerDuty: silenced period ended for PD1234
devon: will follow up with a postmortem note — likely interaction between kv-prefill + routing fallback under load. tagging infra and runtime teams
maria: thanks all — handoff to nora for post-incident tracking. I'm done for now :thumbsup:
nora: taking post-incident, will add remediation items and check alert thresholds to avoid chatter.
